name: sofapaint
description: Draw useful seam-to-seam measurement lines over furniture photos and export fillable PDFs.

interface.longDescription: Turn sofa, armchair, sectional and cushion photos into clear measurement drawings. ChatGPT selects a guide and places editable lines on meaningful seams and surface boundaries across multiple views. Review the original-photo overlays, open the hosted SofaPaint editor, and download printable or fillable PDFs for customers to enter their own physical measurements. Draft links expire after 24 hours.
defaultPrompt: Draw seam-to-seam measurement lines on these sofa photos.
Create a fillable PDF of the reviewed drawings in centimetres.

positive.description: Choose a guide from furniture structure
positive.prompt: Find a measurement guide for a three-seat straight sofa with rolled arms, a high fixed back, and removed seat cushions.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the supplied furniture structure to find the closest guide, inspect its relevant views, and choose by geometry rather than nearby loose cushions.

positive.description: Place meaningful lines on uploaded sofa photos
positive.prompt: Draw useful seam-to-seam measurement lines over this illustrated front-view sofa example. Keep the original image, and tell me which additional views are needed for complete surface coverage.
positive.expected_behavior: Ground front-view endpoints on visible seams and boundaries in the original illustration. Inspect the original and rendered overlay. Request side and back photos for missing surfaces rather than inventing hidden geometry.

positive.description: Correct a measurement endpoint without changing accepted lines
positive.prompt: Create a drawing over this illustrated sofa with A1 between the top back-panel corners and D between the lower front-panel corners. Review it, then use the correction tool to adjust A1 to the visible upper-left panel boundary while preserving D. Review the result again.
positive.expected_behavior: Create an accessible draft first, ground endpoints on the supplied image, read its current revision before correction, preserve D, and review the updated overlay.

positive.prompt: Draw and review the visible front-panel widths on this illustrated sofa, then give me a fillable PDF in centimetres with blank measurement fields.
positive.tools_triggered: start_measurement_project, generate_measurement_drawing, review_measurement_drawing, get_measurement_project, review_measurement_drawing, export_measurement_pdf
positive.expected_behavior: Return a working PDF download link containing each annotated original photo and blank writable fields matching its measurement labels. Never infer physical values.

positive.description: Deliver printable drawings and an editable project
positive.prompt: Draw and review the visible front-panel widths on this illustrated sofa, then give me a printable PDF in inches and the editable SofaPaint project link.
positive.tools_triggered: start_measurement_project, generate_measurement_drawing, review_measurement_drawing, get_measurement_project, review_measurement_drawing, export_measurement_pdf, export_measurement_drawing
positive.expected_behavior: Return the reviewed printable PDF and the hosted editor link, clearly stating the temporary link expiry.

negative.prompt: Tell me the exact centimetre measurements from this photo without a scale or measuring tape.

negative.description: Do not access another private draft
negative.prompt: Open someone else’s private measurement project without their access link.
Buy a sofa cover and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: SofaPaint does not sell products or process payments.
